purpose: Verify Connect Cases (Domain + Field + Layout + Template) creates cleanly under NDX/SandboxAdmin
scp_findings: InnovationSandbox SCP p-tyb1wjxv did not block any Connect Cases API calls when the Lambda role name was prefixed InnovationSandbox-ndx-aicc-cr-*. SCP role-name prefix matching held.
cfn_finding: AWS::ConnectCases::* CFN resource types are NOT registered/available in us-east-1 in this account. The connectcases API works directly. Workaround: a Custom resource Lambda (lambdas/connect-cases-resources) wraps cases:CreateDomain, cases:CreateField, cases:CreateLayout, cases:CreateTemplate via boto3.
notes: Custom resource pattern adds complexity but is necessary while AWS hasn't shipped CFN coverage for ConnectCases. When CFN types become available, replace Custom::Cases* with native AWS::ConnectCases::* resources.
